fields.aka: Śrīnivāsa Ācārya Ṭhākura, Ācārya Prabhu, Śrīnivāsa Ācārya Prabhu
fields.appearance: Vaiśākha Pūrṇimā, 1441 Śaka (1519 CE), at Cākundī north of Agradvīpa, Nadia (Gauḍīya Vaiṣṇava Abhidhāna; B. V. Tīrtha: 1530)
fields.place: Born at Cākundī (Cākhandī), Nadia; lived at Jājigrāma (his grandfather's village); Vana-viṣṇupura
fields.works: Five songs (Karṇānanda, Padakalpataru); commentary on the catuḥ-ślokī of the Bhāgavatam; Śrīman-narahari-ṭhākurāṣṭaka; Ṣaḍ-gosvāmy-guṇa-leśa-sūcaka; the Manoharaśāhī kīrtana style
fields.notes:
Born by Lord Caitanya's blessing to Gaṅgādhara Bhaṭṭācārya (Caitanya dāsa) and Lakṣmīpriyā, daughter of Balarāma Vipra. Dīkṣā from Gopāla Bhaṭṭa Gosvāmī; studied under Jīva Gosvāmī, who gave him the title Ācārya. With Narottama and Śyāmānanda brought the Gosvāmīs' books to Bengal; they were stolen at Vana-viṣṇupura by King Vīra Hāmvīra, whom he converted. Wives: Īśvarī (Draupadī, daughter of Gopāla Cakravartī) and Gaurāṅgapriyā (Padmāvatī, daughter of Rāghava/Raghu Cakravartī of Gopālapura). Children: Vṛndāvana-vallabha, Rādhākṛṣṇa, Gatigovinda; Hemalatā, Kṛṣṇapriyā, Kāñcanalatikā (or Phulapi). Dearest disciple: Rāmacandra Kavirāja; the six Cakravartīs, the eight Kavirājas. Performed the abhiṣeka of the six Deities at Kheturī.

Dates/place from the Gauḍīya Vaiṣṇava Abhidhāna (B. V. Tīrtha, “Sri Chaitanya: His Associates”, gives 1530).

His texts were in record #1465 «Śrīnivāsa Ṭhākura» until 05-11-2026 (moved here at Whisper's request).

Parents were Śrī Lakṣmīpriyā and Śrī Gaṅgadhara Bhaṭṭācārya. He was born on the full moon day of Vaisaka month when Rohiṇī star was visible, as predicted by his father's astrological friend.

Father: Śrī Gaṅgadhara Bhaṭṭācārya (Caitanya Dās). Mother: Lakṣmīpriyā, daughter of Balarām Vipra. Identity in Kṛṣṇa-līlā: Gaura-śakti and a great soul who received darśan from many devotees.

05-11-2026: its only text (the life of Śrīnivāsa Ācārya) was moved to #1466 «Śrīnivāsa Ācārya» at Whisper's request; this record is kept apart by Whisper's decision.
